note: Crispy Spicy Beef Noodles: chilli garlic paste (hard to find in CZ) replaced 1:1 by sriracha

daySteps: Reheat in the microwave or a pan with a splash of water. It tastes even better after a day in the fridge. Make sure it is steaming hot all the way through (stir halfway), and reheat only the portion you will eat.
data.name: Crispy Spicy Beef Noodles
data.note: From Jalal Sam Fit (card: 521 kcal, P 54 · C 56 · F 8 for ¼ of the batch). Portions rescaled to the nutritionist's dinner target. Spices and herbs are in the ingredient list in grams (converted from the spoon amounts) and count towards the nutrition. Spice amounts in the steps follow the servings you cook. Onion and green onion swapped for extra bell pepper (Anna). Frozen mixed veg (100 g per portion) added for fibre. Regular butter replaces light butter (not sold in CZ), cut to about 73 % of the weight so fat and calories stay the same. Sriracha replaces chilli garlic paste (hard to find in CZ), same amount; add an extra ½ tsp chilli flakes for more heat.
prepSteps: Sauce: in a bowl mix the soy sauce ({=sojova-omacka}), honey ({=med}), sweet chilli sauce ({=sladka-chilli-omacka}), rice vinegar ({=ryzovy-ocet}), sriracha ({=sriracha}), {q:1 tsp} red pepper flakes, half the sesame seeds ({=sezam:50%|spoon}) and {q:20 ml} water.

Pan plan: {=hovezi-mlete-libove-5} of mince is more than one pan can brown. Cook it in rounds of about 500 g so the water evaporates and it browns instead of stewing, or use two pans. Tip each finished round into a bowl and bring it all back together for the next step. If the browned bits on the pan turn dark brown or burn between rounds, deglaze with a splash of water or wipe the pan. Mince is done when no pink is left.
In a pan on medium-high heat melt the butter ({=maslo}) and cook the mince ({=hovezi-mlete-libove-5}) for 6–8 min until browned and most of the liquid has evaporated.
Lower to medium, add half the sauce and a third of the diced pepper ({=paprika:1/3}, it replaces the onion and green onion) and cook 5 min more until golden and crispy. Set aside.
Put the noodles ({=vajecne-nudle}) in a bowl of boiling water for 5 min, then drain so they don't go mushy.
In the same pan cook the chopped garlic ({=cesnek}) and ginger ({=zazvor}) for 3–4 min until fragrant, add the rest of the pepper ({=paprika:rest}), sliced, and cook 5 min until soft.
On low heat add the noodles with the rest of the sauce and mix until fully coated. Fold the beef back in gently and top with the rest of the sesame seeds ({=sezam:rest|spoon}).

Cook the frozen mixed veg ({=mrazena-zeleninova-smes}, a mix without onion) in the microwave or a steamer and divide everything into boxes. Keep the boxes open with the food no more than about 4 cm deep and leave it until it stops steaming, about 30 min. Refrigerate within 2 hours of cooking and close the lids once cool, not while warm.
